purpose: Provide a finite, reproducible perimeter for the two consecutive clean full-corpus sweeps required before Radar Opportunity discovery hardening can begin.

gate.rule: A sweep is clean when a complete pass over the frozen oracle set and included opportunity classes produces zero new current actionable gaps relative to the reference snapshot plus the documented audit corpus through Wave 18.
gate.scopeExpansionRule: A newly discovered opportunity family outside this frozen corpus may be logged as out_of_corpus_candidate_for_v2, but does not reset the v1 clean-sweep counter unless the corpus is explicitly revised and versioned before the sweep.

allRequired: official primary evidence establishes an open or rolling lifecycle on the audit date
at least one of the seven municipalities is formally eligible as applicant, borrower, requester, required beneficiary, required public procurer, or concrete conditional consortium/partner participant

there is a concrete operational benefit: funding, subsidised finance, asset transfer, technical assistance, capacity building, expert support, project access, award/label, investor/project matchmaking, replicator/FSTP support or innovation-procurement participation
the opportunity has a documented application/request/submission/consortium route rather than only thematic relevance
canonical snapshot, municipality_eligibility, coverage rules and internal_review are checked before absence is asserted
the case is not already documented as a known current gap in Waves 1-18

excludedFromV1Gate: general network membership with no discrete support/application benefit
knowledge platforms or newsletters without an operational request route
consultations, surveys, questionnaires and policy feedback exercises
events, webinars, conferences and training attendance without a structured funded/support programme
supplier-side public procurement and commercial tenders
generic financial institution capability pages without an explicit municipal borrower/request route
mere stakeholder/end-user mentions without a beneficiary, procurer, applicant or concrete partner route
predetermined beneficiary lists that exclude all seven municipalities
closed calls and pre-launch historical misses for purposes of the clean counter
announced future calls before their actual opening date
new opportunity families or new oracle families introduced after this freeze unless corpus v2 is explicitly approved

corpusRevisionPolicy: Any change to oracle membership or included/excluded classes requires a new corpus version. The v1 gate is evaluated only against this file.
